exhibits.label: Table 8.1
exhibits.title: DDPG architecture search
exhibits.note: One training run of 12500 frames per row. SS reward: reward at the deterministic closed-loop steady state of the selected checkpoint; -inf when no checkpoint has one, in which case the final weights are kept. Eval reward: mean per-step reward of the selected agent over 50 stochastic episodes. Candidates: checkpoints that met the H&T selection criterion. The linear actor has no hidden layer, so its actor size is fixed at 1.

exhibits.label: Table 8.2
exhibits.title: Chosen numbers of hidden nodes
exhibits.note: Counterpart of Hinterlang & Tänzer (2021, Table 2). x1 = (y, pi); x2 adds one lag of each.

exhibits.label: Table 8.3
exhibits.title: Effective Taylor coefficients of the DDPG policies
exhibits.note: OLS of the clipped policy rate on a grid over the observation, in the level form of Hinterlang & Tänzer (2021, Table 4). x1 policies are fitted on a (pi, y) grid; x2 policies on a grid over (pi, pi_lag, y, y_lag), so the lag coefficients are fitted, not set to zero. A policy that observes the previous rate is evaluated with it held at 4 percent (r* + pi*). R2 measures how well a linear rule describes the policy.

exhibits.note: Undiscounted episode return, 25-episode rolling mean, including the random warm-up episodes. Rows: economies; columns: observation and variant.
